policy: Issues discovered during Phase 22 execution. Open items are honest blockers/limits, not hidden failures. Append-only across phases.

items.title: Flaky temp path collision in driver-install coordinator tests (Part A repair)
items.detail: Supervisor re-verification found protection_barrier_precedes_every_fake_mutation_and_completes panicking at Database::open under parallel cargo runs: temp_root() built its scratch directory from pid + wall-clock nanos, which two test threads can share on a coarse clock.
items.fix: temp_root() now anchors uniqueness with a function-local AtomicU32 counter (pid-{seq}-{nanos}); std-only, no new dependency; every call site uses the shared helper.
items.evidence: 10 consecutive isolated runs of the coordinator suite all green; two consecutive full workspace runs both exactly 343 passed / 0 failed. Also logged as closed P21-ISS-004 in docs/phase21/ISSUES.json.

items.title: Embedded Phase 21 audit exited the Phase 22 superset early
items.detail: phase22-adversarial-audit.py imports and executes phase21-adversarial-audit.py in-process to inherit its checks; that script ends with sys.exit(0), terminating the superset after only the inherited gates.
items.resolution: The in-process exec now catches SystemExit before running the Phase 22 gate block.

items.title: Live domain dispatch inside a care run is intentionally not fabricated
items.detail: ServiceExecutor returns a typed DomainRejected for live runs instead of inventing per-domain success. The orchestration machinery (composition, firewall, consent, single-flight lease, journaled resume, fence cancel, truth-first report) is complete and tested against the executor trait boundary; wiring real coordinators' headless start paths into the run thread remains open.
